'''Project Siantide''' was a project developed by the four [[General/Legends|Generals]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[War Trust]] in the early stages of the [[Galactic War]] in [[3642 BBY]]. The key to the project was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where the residual remains of millions of life-forms incinerated during the [[Destruction of Taris]] in [[3956 BBY]] were exposed to radiation from a reactor core, creating an extremely powerful energy source that would increase the potency of Republic weapons tenfold. Unfortunately for the Republic, [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]] decided to eliminate the War Trust and send his [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] to Taris to hunt them all down. One by one, Republic generals were exposed and killed, while the technology and infrastructure necessary for Project: Siantide was destroyed, leaving the remaining Republic survivors at a dead end.
